finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Every `.js` file passes `node --check`. Repo-wide grep shows no `db.query` left outside vendor.

Left alone on purpose:

- `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` and `:13`. Header says do not edit. It is replaced on upgrade.
- `cache.query(...)` in 24 files. Different object. Not part of this.

Next: ask upstream `legacy-orm` for a version on `execute`, or wrap the vendor calls.
